content: Consensus: a mutable current_owner/assigned_to column keeps only latest state and destroys history; full event sourcing is overkill for small apps. The standard hybrid is a mutable current-state table plus an append-only assignment_events table (asset_id, event_type, from, to, timestamp, actor) written in the same transaction. Azure Architecture Center documents CRUD weakness on auditability; RisingStack, Nurkiewicz, ACM OEP, and PTS audit-trail guides corroborate the hybrid pattern.
